text:
Tool: engineer_run_process
Purpose: Run an allow-listed build, test, compiler, or diagnostic process without a command shell.
When to use: Use after edits to run the host-approved compiler, build, test, or diagnostic command. Inspect the captured exit code and output before deciding the next action.
Minimum access: ENGINEER.
Risk class: execute.
Workspace scoped: yes.
Always requires approval: no.
Arguments schema: {"additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"command": {"description": "Executable and arguments as separate values; shell syntax is not accepted.", "items": {"type": "string"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}, "cwd": {"default": ".", "type": "string"}, "timeout_seconds": {"default": 120, "maximum": 600, "minimum": 1, "type": "integer"}}, "required": ["command"], "type": "object"}
title: Use engineer_run_process

text:
Tool: workspace_create_directory
Purpose: Create a directory inside the open project, including missing parents.
When to use: Use to establish a requested project or module layout. It succeeds when the directory already exists.
Minimum access: WORKSPACE.
Risk class: write.
Workspace scoped: yes.
Always requires approval: no.
Arguments schema: {"additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"path": {"description": "Path relative to the open project.", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["path"], "type": "object"}
title: Use workspace_create_directory

text:
Tool: workspace_create_file
Purpose: Create a new UTF-8 source, specification, or documentation file without overwriting an existing file.
When to use: Use for new files. If the file exists, read it and use workspace_replace_text or request workspace_overwrite_file.
Minimum access: WORKSPACE.
Risk class: write.
Workspace scoped: yes.
Always requires approval: no.
Arguments schema: {"additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"content": {"type": "string"}, "path": {"description": "Path relative to the open project.", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["path", "content"], "type": "object"}
title: Use workspace_create_file

text:
Tool: workspace_list
Purpose: List files and directories in the open project.
When to use: Use before assuming a project layout or choosing a file to inspect.
Minimum access: OBSERVE.
Risk class: read.
Workspace scoped: yes.
Always requires approval: no.
Arguments schema: {"additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"limit": {"default": 200, "maximum": 1000, "minimum": 1, "type": "integer"}, "path": {"description": "Path relative to the open project.", "type": "string"}, "recursive": {"default": false, "type": "boolean"}}, "required": [], "type": "object"}
title: Use workspace_list

text:
Tool: workspace_overwrite_file
Purpose: Replace the complete contents of an existing UTF-8 project file.
When to use: Use only when a complete rewrite is genuinely required. This tool always requires exact user approval.
Minimum access: WORKSPACE.
Risk class: write.
Workspace scoped: yes.
Always requires approval: yes.
Arguments schema: {"additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"content": {"type": "string"}, "path": {"description": "Path relative to the open project.", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["path", "content"], "type": "object"}
title: Use workspace_overwrite_file

text:
Tool: workspace_read
Purpose: Read a UTF-8 project file with line numbers and optional line bounds.
When to use: Read specifications and surrounding source before proposing or making an edit. Use line bounds for large files.
Minimum access: OBSERVE.
Risk class: read.
Workspace scoped: yes.
Always requires approval: no.
Arguments schema: {"additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"end_line": {"minimum": 1, "type": "integer"}, "path": {"description": "Path relative to the open project.", "type": "string"}, "start_line": {"default": 1, "minimum": 1, "type": "integer"}}, "required": ["path"], "type": "object"}
title: Use workspace_read

text:
Tool: workspace_replace_text
Purpose: Replace exact text in an existing UTF-8 project file.
When to use: Use for focused edits after reading the file. By default the old text must occur exactly once, preventing ambiguous edits.
Minimum access: WORKSPACE.
Risk class: write.
Workspace scoped: yes.
Always requires approval: no.
Arguments schema: {"additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"new_text": {"type": "string"}, "old_text": {"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}, "path": {"description": "Path relative to the open project.", "type": "string"}, "replace_all": {"default": false, "type": "boolean"}}, "required": ["path", "old_text", "new_text"], "type": "object"}
title: Use workspace_replace_text

text:
Tool: workspace_search
Purpose: Search text files in the project and return matching paths, lines, and excerpts.
When to use: Use to find definitions, references, requirements, and relevant documentation before editing.
Minimum access: OBSERVE.
Risk class: read.
Workspace scoped: yes.
Always requires approval: no.
Arguments schema: {"additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"file_pattern": {"default": "*", "type": "string"}, "limit": {"default": 50, "maximum": 200, "minimum": 1, "type": "integer"}, "path": {"description": "Path relative to the open project.", "type": "string"}, "query": {"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}}, "required": ["query"], "type": "object"}
title: Use workspace_search
